---
title: "Presentations"
description: "Conference papers, panels and invited talks."
listing:
  id: presentations
  contents: presentations.yml
  type: default
  sort: "date desc"
  date-format: "MMMM YYYY"
  fields: [date, title, categories, description]
  categories: true
---

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const listing = document.querySelector("#listing-presentations");
  if (!listing) return;

  const normalizeLinks = () => {
    const pageUrl = new URL(window.location.href);
    listing.querySelectorAll("a").forEach((link) => {
      const linkUrl = new URL(link.href, pageUrl);
      if (linkUrl.origin === pageUrl.origin && linkUrl.pathname === pageUrl.pathname) {
        link.closest("h3.listing-title")?.classList.add("presentation-title-no-link");
        link.replaceWith(...link.childNodes);
        return;
      }

      link.target = "_blank";
      link.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
    });
  };

  normalizeLinks();
  new MutationObserver(normalizeLinks).observe(listing, {
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ["href"],
    childList: true,
    subtree: true
  });
});
</script>
